summary: BBB Foods Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, reporting its first quarter 2026 earnings. The release covers standard operational and financial results: net store openings, revenue growth of 33.4%, same-store sales growth of 16.0%, and EBITDA (including share-based payment adjustments). No material definitive agreement, M&A activity, tender offer, or board change is disclosed. This is a routine earnings filing by a foreign private issuer.
